title: Rejects a many-to-one relation
description: Believes a relation with a repeated output cannot be a function.
observableError: Chose a relation in which two inputs share an output.
feedback: Believes a relation with a repeated output cannot be a function.

title: Rejects a constant relation
description: Believes a relation whose outputs are all equal cannot be a function.
observableError: Chose a relation whose outputs are all equal.
feedback: Believes a relation whose outputs are all equal cannot be a function.

title: Requires a pattern
description: Believes a relation must follow a formula or an ordered pattern to be a function.
observableError: Chose a relation with no visible pattern.
feedback: Believes a relation must follow a formula or an ordered pattern to be a function.

title: Adds the coefficient instead of multiplying
description: Reads ax as a + x when substituting.
observableError: Added the coefficient to the input instead of multiplying.

distractorRule.summary: Adds the coefficient instead of multiplying

feedback: Reads ax as a + x when substituting.

title: Drops the constant term
description: Evaluates the variable part of the rule and forgets the constant term.
observableError: Left out the constant term of the rule.
feedback: Evaluates the variable part of the rule and forgets the constant term.

title: Drops the sign of a negative input
description: Substitutes |x| instead of a negative input.
observableError: Substituted the positive value instead of the negative input.

distractorRule.summary: Drops the sign of a negative input

feedback: Substitutes |x| instead of a negative input.

title: Flips the sign of the constant
description: Subtracts the constant that should be added (or vice versa).
observableError: Used the opposite sign on the constant term.

distractorRule.summary: Flips the sign of the constant
distractorRule.expression: a p - b  /  a p^2 + b p - c

feedback: Subtracts the constant that should be added (or vice versa).

title: Squares a negative input to a negative
description: Computes (-p)^2 as -p^2.
observableError: Treated the square of a negative input as negative.

distractorRule.summary: Squares a negative input to a negative

feedback: Computes (-p)^2 as -p^2.

title: Squares the coefficient as well
description: Computes a x^2 as (a x)^2.
observableError: Squared the coefficient together with the input.
feedback: Computes a x^2 as (a x)^2.

title: Treats x^2 as 2x
description: Doubles the input instead of squaring it.
observableError: Doubled the input instead of squaring it.
feedback: Doubles the input instead of squaring it.

title: Ungroups the denominator
description: Divides by x alone and treats the rest of the denominator as a separate term.
observableError: Divided by x alone instead of by the whole denominator.
feedback: Divides by x alone and treats the rest of the denominator as a separate term.

title: Inverts the fraction
description: Divides the denominator by the numerator.
observableError: Inverted the fraction when evaluating.
feedback: Divides the denominator by the numerator.

title: Ignores the square root
description: Evaluates the radicand and forgets to take the root.
observableError: Did not take the square root.
feedback: Evaluates the radicand and forgets to take the root.

title: Halves instead of rooting
description: Divides the radicand by 2 instead of taking its square root.
observableError: Halved the radicand instead of taking its square root.
feedback: Divides the radicand by 2 instead of taking its square root.

title: Takes the negative root
description: Uses the negative square root for the radical symbol.
observableError: Used the negative square root.
feedback: Uses the negative square root for the radical symbol.

title: Evaluates instead of solving
description: Substitutes the given output as if it were the input.
observableError: Substituted the output value into the rule instead of solving for the input.
feedback: Substitutes the given output as if it were the input.

title: Wrong inverse operation on the constant
description: Adds the constant instead of subtracting it when isolating the variable term.
observableError: Used the wrong inverse operation on the constant.

distractorRule.summary: Wrong inverse operation on the constant

feedback: Adds the constant instead of subtracting it when isolating the variable term.

title: Stops before dividing by the coefficient
description: Reports the isolated variable term as the variable.
observableError: Isolated the variable term but did not divide by its coefficient.

distractorRule.summary: Stops before dividing by the coefficient

feedback: Reports the isolated variable term as the variable.

title: Divides by the constant
description: Divides by the constant term instead of the coefficient of x.
observableError: Divided by the constant term instead of by the coefficient of x.
feedback: Divides by the constant term instead of the coefficient of x.

title: Does not invert the reciprocal
description: Multiplies by the numerator instead of dividing the numerator by the isolated value.
observableError: Treated the reciprocal like a linear coefficient.
feedback: Multiplies by the numerator instead of dividing the numerator by the isolated value.

title: Sign error at the pole
description: Subtracts the shift of the denominator instead of adding it back.
observableError: Used the wrong sign when undoing the shift inside the denominator.
feedback: Subtracts the shift of the denominator instead of adding it back.

title: Ignores the vertical shift
description: Does not remove the added constant before inverting the fraction.
observableError: Did not subtract the constant before undoing the fraction.
feedback: Does not remove the added constant before inverting the fraction.

title: Forgets to square
description: Removes the root without squaring the other side.
observableError: Did not square both sides to remove the root.
feedback: Removes the root without squaring the other side.

title: Squares before isolating the root
description: Squares the whole output before removing the added constant.
observableError: Squared before isolating the square root.
feedback: Squares the whole output before removing the added constant.

title: Domain is always all reals
description: Ignores the restriction imposed by a root or a denominator.
observableError: Gave all real numbers although the rule has a restriction.
feedback: Ignores the restriction imposed by a root or a denominator.

title: Inequality direction flipped
description: Reverses (or fails to reverse) the inequality when solving the radicand condition.
observableError: Solved the radicand inequality in the wrong direction.
feedback: Reverses (or fails to reverse) the inequality when solving the radicand condition.

title: Excludes the endpoint
description: Uses a strict inequality, excluding the input where the radicand is 0.
observableError: Excluded the endpoint where the radicand is zero.
feedback: Uses a strict inequality, excluding the input where the radicand is 0.

title: Sign error in the endpoint
description: Solves the radicand inequality with a sign slip in the constant.
observableError: Made a sign error solving for the boundary input.
feedback: Solves the radicand inequality with a sign slip in the constant.

title: Treats the root like a denominator
description: Excludes the single input where the radicand is 0 instead of requiring it to be non-negative.
observableError: Excluded one point instead of solving the inequality.

distractorRule.summary: Treats the root like a denominator

feedback: Excludes the single input where the radicand is 0 instead of requiring it to be non-negative.

title: Sign error at the pole
description: Excludes the negative of the pole.
observableError: Excluded the input with the wrong sign.
feedback: Excludes the negative of the pole.

title: Excludes zero by habit
description: Excludes x = 0 rather than the input that actually breaks the rule.
observableError: Excluded zero instead of the actual restriction.
feedback: Excludes x = 0 rather than the input that actually breaks the rule.

title: Turns the pole into an inequality
description: Writes an inequality instead of excluding the single undefined input.
observableError: Wrote an inequality instead of excluding one value.

distractorRule.summary: Turns the pole into an inequality

feedback: Writes an inequality instead of excluding the single undefined input.

title: Non-negative inputs only
description: Restricts a polynomial rule to x >= 0.
observableError: Restricted the domain to non-negative inputs without reason.
feedback: Restricts a polynomial rule to x >= 0.

title: Excludes the constant term
description: Excludes the constant of the rule as if it were a pole.
observableError: Excluded the value of the constant term.
feedback: Excludes the constant of the rule as if it were a pole.

title: Range is always all reals
description: Ignores the bound imposed by the shape of the graph.
observableError: Gave all real numbers although the outputs are bounded.
feedback: Ignores the bound imposed by the shape of the graph.

title: Bound on the wrong side
description: Uses the wrong direction of inequality for the bounded range.
observableError: Gave the inequality in the wrong direction.
feedback: Uses the wrong direction of inequality for the bounded range.

title: Uses the vertex x-coordinate
description: Reports the axis of symmetry as the bound of the range.
observableError: Used the x-coordinate of the vertex as the bound.
feedback: Reports the axis of symmetry as the bound of the range.

title: Excludes the attained bound
description: Uses a strict inequality although the extreme value is attained.
observableError: Excluded the attained extreme value.
feedback: Uses a strict inequality although the extreme value is attained.

title: Uses the constant term as the bound
description: Takes the y-intercept as the minimum or maximum.
observableError: Used the y-intercept as the extreme value.

distractorRule.summary: Uses the constant term as the bound

feedback: Takes the y-intercept as the minimum or maximum.

title: Ignores the vertical shift
description: States the range of the unshifted base function.
observableError: Ignored the vertical shift.
feedback: States the range of the unshifted base function.

title: Confuses domain and range
description: Gives the domain (in y) instead of the range.
observableError: Gave the domain instead of the range.
feedback: Gives the domain (in y) instead of the range.

title: Turns the missing value into an inequality
description: Writes y > v instead of y != v.
observableError: Wrote an inequality instead of excluding one value.

distractorRule.summary: Turns the missing value into an inequality

feedback: Writes y > v instead of y != v.

title: States only one bound
description: Reports only the lower bound of a bounded range.
observableError: Gave only one of the two bounds.
feedback: Reports only the lower bound of a bounded range.

title: Open interval for a closed domain
description: Uses strict inequalities although the endpoint images are attained.
observableError: Excluded the attained endpoint images.

distractorRule.summary: Open interval for a closed domain

feedback: Uses strict inequalities although the endpoint images are attained.

title: Reverses the order of composition
description: Applies the outer function first.
observableError: Composed the functions in the wrong order.
feedback: Applies the outer function first.

title: Composition as a product
description: Multiplies the two functions.
observableError: Multiplied the functions instead of composing them.
feedback: Multiplies the two functions.

title: Composition as a sum
description: Adds the two functions.
observableError: Added the functions instead of composing them.
feedback: Adds the two functions.

title: Stops after the inner function
description: Reports the inner value without applying the outer function.
observableError: Applied only the inner function.
feedback: Reports the inner value without applying the outer function.

title: Applies only the outer function
description: Evaluates the outer function directly at the input.
observableError: Applied only the outer function at the input.
feedback: Evaluates the outer function directly at the input.

title: Squares a binomial without the cross term
description: Expands (mx + n)^2 as m^2 x^2 + n^2.
observableError: Dropped the cross term when squaring the inner expression.

distractorRule.summary: Squares a binomial without the cross term

feedback: Expands (mx + n)^2 as m^2 x^2 + n^2.

title: Takes the composite as f
description: Reports the composite itself as the outer function.
observableError: Gave the composite instead of the outer function.
feedback: Reports the composite itself as the outer function.

title: Does not invert the inner shift
description: Substitutes x + c instead of x - c when changing variable.
observableError: Undid the inner shift with the wrong sign.

distractorRule.summary: Does not invert the inner shift

feedback: Substitutes x + c instead of x - c when changing variable.

title: Does not invert the inner scale
description: Multiplies by the inner coefficient instead of dividing.
observableError: Undid the inner scale by multiplying instead of dividing.

distractorRule.summary: Does not invert the inner scale

feedback: Multiplies by the inner coefficient instead of dividing.

title: Composes instead of decomposing
description: Substitutes g into the composite.
observableError: Composed with the inner function instead of undoing it.
feedback: Substitutes g into the composite.

title: Inverse as reciprocal
description: Confuses the inverse function with the reciprocal of the function.
observableError: Gave the reciprocal instead of the inverse function.
feedback: Confuses the inverse function with the reciprocal of the function.

title: Undoes the operations in the wrong order
description: Divides before undoing the constant.
observableError: Undid the operations in the wrong order.

distractorRule.summary: Undoes the operations in the wrong order

feedback: Divides before undoing the constant.

title: Sign error undoing the constant
description: Adds the constant that should be subtracted (or vice versa).
observableError: Used the wrong sign when undoing the constant.
feedback: Adds the constant that should be subtracted (or vice versa).

title: Negates the constant only
description: Keeps the multiplication and only flips the sign of the constant.
observableError: Only changed the sign of the constant.
feedback: Keeps the multiplication and only flips the sign of the constant.

title: Swaps the coefficient and the constant
description: Divides by the constant and subtracts the coefficient.
observableError: Swapped the roles of the coefficient and the constant.

distractorRule.summary: Swaps the coefficient and the constant

feedback: Divides by the constant and subtracts the coefficient.

title: Evaluates f instead of f^-1
description: Substitutes the value into f rather than solving f(x) = value.
observableError: Evaluated the function instead of its inverse.
feedback: Substitutes the value into f rather than solving f(x) = value.

title: Inverse value as a reciprocal
description: Computes 1/f(value).
observableError: Took the reciprocal of the function value.
feedback: Computes 1/f(value).

title: Applies the inverse a second time
description: Applies f^-1 to the given input instead of f.
observableError: Applied the inverse to the given value instead of the function.

distractorRule.summary: Applies the inverse a second time

feedback: Applies f^-1 to the given input instead of f.

title: Reads the equation as the identity
description: Reports the given input as the unknown.
observableError: Reported the given value as the answer.

distractorRule.summary: Reads the equation as the identity

feedback: Reports the given input as the unknown.

title: Axis of symmetry without the half
description: Uses -b/a for the axis of symmetry.
observableError: Omitted the factor 2 in the axis of symmetry.

distractorRule.summary: Axis of symmetry without the half

feedback: Uses -b/a for the axis of symmetry.

title: Axis of symmetry with the wrong sign
description: Uses b/(2a) for the axis of symmetry.
observableError: Used the wrong sign in the axis of symmetry.

distractorRule.summary: Axis of symmetry with the wrong sign

feedback: Uses b/(2a) for the axis of symmetry.

title: Uses the vertex value
description: Reports the minimum/maximum value instead of where it occurs.
observableError: Gave the vertex value instead of its x-coordinate.
feedback: Reports the minimum/maximum value instead of where it occurs.

title: Assumes the restriction is x = 0
description: Restricts at 0 regardless of the axis of symmetry.
observableError: Assumed the axis of symmetry is x = 0.
feedback: Restricts at 0 regardless of the axis of symmetry.

title: Uses the constant term in the axis
description: Substitutes the constant term for the x coefficient in -b/(2a).
observableError: Used the constant term in place of the x coefficient.

distractorRule.summary: Uses the constant term in the axis

feedback: Substitutes the constant term for the x coefficient in -b/(2a).
